request: Correct the transparent-looking top where the rear copper ring remained visible through the finial assembly.
route: deterministic img2threejs geometry correction followed by source GLB export, Blender front and three-quarter occlusion validation, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild
userDecision: revision-requested because the copper element must remain a real torus ring whose far arc is naturally depth-occluded during orbit, not a solid disc
rootCause: No material was transparent. The copper collar was an open torus wrapped around a narrow stone core, so its rear semicircle remained visible and created a see-through illusion.
changes: replaced the open donut-shaped torus with a closed capped copper cylinder collar
widened the limestone finial base and lower finial profile
overlapped the opaque stone core through the collar so the rear side is fully depth-occluded
retained the integrated finial channels and physical basin-rim gaps from prior corrections
limitations: Vertical wall and upper-bowl seams remain separate embedded solids rather than destructive mortar cuts.
Water jets and impacts remain runtime or review effects excluded from structural GLB and FBX geometry.
Android device performance and final user art-direction approval remain pending.
